points.K10: 用小烧杯给滴定管加液
points.K11: 擦净瓶外液滴，盖严瓶盖
points.K12: 滴定管加液：低于视线、慢倒、接盘
points.K14: 不伸进原瓶，不倒回原瓶
points.K15: 剩余试剂：分享或进废液桶
points.K17: 称量：少量多次，多取不倒回
points.K18: 洒落即清，称完立即入瓶
points.K19: 电热板：查电线、离热面、放干处
points.K20: 有害气体和易燃溶剂进通风柜
points.K21: 热物看不出来，用对钳子
points.K25: 水槽不留物，碎玻璃告诉老师
points.K29: 时刻留意，实验前想四步
points.S1: 实验个人防护基本要求
points.S3: 碎玻璃收集与割伤处置
points.S5: 加热不离人，离开断电断气
points.S7: 化学品溅到身上怎么办

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在整洁的化学实验台前，台上摆着滴定架和电热板，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a tidy chemistry lab bench with a titration stand and a hot plate, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲化学实验里降低风险的操作技巧。
overlay: 降低风险：化学实验的操作技巧

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 四个图标排成一行：整洁台面、滴定管、烧瓶加热、废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a tidy bench, a burette, a flask on a hot plate, and a waste container with a lid. No people.
shots.narration: 实验前、滴定、合成、实验后，逐一来看。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰的实验台上堆着书包、奶茶杯、手机和一堆没贴标签的烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's lab bench is cluttered with a backpack, a takeaway cup, a phone and many unlabeled beakers of clear liquid.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次上化学实验课，台面乱成一团。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拿起两只看起来一样的透明溶液烧杯，满脸困惑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up two identical beakers of clear liquid with blank sides, looking confused.
shots.narration: 两杯透明液体，哪杯是哪杯？他分不清了。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研（助教）走过来，指着台面摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, working as a teaching assistant in a lab coat and goggles, walks over and points at the messy bench, shaking her head.
shots.narration: 助教小研走过来：先别急着做。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 很多风险，靠操作习惯就能降下来。

shots.section_title: 防护装备按风险评估来选
shots.scene: 欣欣举着护目镜和手套，旁边是空白的风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up safety goggles and a pair of gloves next to a blank risk assessment form on an easel.
shots.narration: 穿戴什么防护，要先看风险评估。
overlay: 防护装备按风险评估来选

shots.section_title: 防护装备按风险评估来选
shots.scene: 化学品瓶和实验条件图标，箭头指向护目镜、手套、实验服
shots.prompt_en: Icons of chemical bottles and a flame lead with arrows to icons of goggles, gloves and a lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 按用到的化学品和实验条件来选定。

shots.section_title: 防护装备按风险评估来选
shots.scene: 一张没有任何试剂瓶的空实验台，旁边是打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: An empty lab bench with no chemical bottles at all, and a green check mark icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 台上没有化学品时，才谈得上不穿防护。

shots.section_title: 四步法中的“降低风险”
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁四个台阶图标，第三级亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four step icons going up; the third step glows.
shots.narration: 安全四步：识别、评估、降低、准备。
overlay: 四步法中的“降低风险”

shots.section_title: 四步法中的“降低风险”
shots.scene: 前两级台阶打勾，第三级上放着工具箱图标
shots.prompt_en: The first two steps have green check marks; a toolbox icon sits on the third step. No people.
shots.narration: 假定危害已识别、风险已评估。

shots.section_title: 四步法中的“降低风险”
shots.scene: 工具箱打开，里面是各种操作图标
shots.prompt_en: The toolbox opens, showing small icons of a beaker, tongs, a label and a pipette bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 这一课，就讲降低风险的具体做法。

shots.section_title: 好习惯就能降低风险
shots.scene: 三个图标：化学品飞溅、手指受伤、损坏的仪器，各自被盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a chemical splash, an injured finger and a broken instrument, each blocked by a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 好的操作习惯，能减少接触、受伤和损失。
overlay: 好习惯就能降低风险

shots.section_title: 台面整洁，无关物品收起
shots.scene: 杂乱的台面图标：书包、乱放的瓶子，旁边有绊倒和洒漏的小图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cluttered bench with a backpack and scattered bottles, with small trip and spill warning icons. No people.
shots.narration: 台面杂乱，容易绊倒、洒漏、拿错试剂。
overlay: 台面整洁，无关物品收起

shots.section_title: 台面整洁，无关物品收起
shots.scene: 阿杰把书包和杯子放进实验室门口的储物柜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his backpack and cup into a locker by the lab entrance.
shots.narration: 书包和与实验无关的东西，先收起来。

shots.section_title: 台面整洁，无关物品收起
shots.scene: 阿杰的台面变得整洁，只剩实验要用的器材
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's bench is now tidy, holding only the glassware needed for the experiment.
shots.narration: 工作区保持干净整齐。

shots.section_title: 时常退一步，审视台面
shots.scene: 阿杰后退一步，打量整个台面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student steps back from the bench and looks over the whole work area.
shots.narration: 做实验时，时常退一步看看台面。
overlay: 时常退一步，审视台面

shots.section_title: 时常退一步，审视台面
shots.scene: 不用的玻璃器皿和多余试剂瓶被放回柜子
shots.prompt_en: Unused glassware and extra chemical bottles being put back into a cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 不用的器皿和设备，及时收走。

shots.section_title: 时常退一步，审视台面
shots.scene: 台上多余的试剂瓶图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of extra chemical bottles crowding a bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用不着的化学品，别留在台面上。

shots.section_title: 废物及时处理，别误丢试剂
shots.scene: 阿杰把废液倒入贴着空白标签的废液容器，小研在旁指导
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pours used liquid into a waste container with a blank label while the female graduate student watches and guides.
shots.narration: 废物产生后，按老师要求及时处理。
overlay: 废物及时处理，别误丢试剂

shots.section_title: 废物及时处理，别误丢试剂
shots.scene: 一只还要用的试剂烧杯正被倒向废液桶，被红叉拦住
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beaker of reagent still needed being tipped toward a waste container, stopped by a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 但别把后面还要用的试剂当废物丢掉。

shots.section_title: 本子、手机、计算器远离化学品
shots.scene: 记录本、笔记本电脑、手机、计算器图标远离一排试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a notebook, a laptop, a phone and a calculator placed away from a row of chemical bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 记录本、电脑、手机、计算器远离化学品。
overlay: 本子、手机、计算器远离化学品

shots.section_title: 本子、手机、计算器远离化学品
shots.scene: 阿杰把手机和计算器装进透明自封袋
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slides his phone and calculator into a clear zip bag.
shots.narration: 手机和计算器，可以装进密封袋。

shots.section_title: 玻璃器皿先查裂纹
shots.scene: 小研把滴定管、移液管、烧杯、锥形瓶摆在台上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lays out a burette, a pipette, a beaker and a conical flask on the bench.
shots.narration: 滴定要用到不少玻璃器皿。
overlay: 玻璃器皿先查裂纹

shots.section_title: 玻璃器皿先查裂纹
shots.scene: 阿杰举起烧杯对着光转动查看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, in goggles and gloves, holds a beaker up to the light and turns it to inspect it.
shots.narration: 用之前，对着光转一圈查裂纹。

shots.section_title: 玻璃器皿先查裂纹
shots.scene: 烧杯放大图：杯口星状裂纹、杯身发丝状细纹被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A magnified beaker icon with a star-shaped crack at the rim and a thin hairline crack on the side, both circled. No people.
shots.narration: 星状裂纹、发丝细纹，都要留意。

shots.section_title: 玻璃器皿先查裂纹
shots.scene: 有裂纹的烧杯放在加热板上碎开的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cracked beaker breaking apart on a hot plate, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有裂纹的器皿，一碰一加热就会碎。

shots.section_title: 玻璃器皿先查裂纹
shots.scene: 有裂纹的烧杯被放进单独的收集盒
shots.prompt_en: A cracked beaker is placed into a separate collection box with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 发现裂纹，换掉不用，交给老师处理。

shots.section_title: 使用中的容器临时贴标签
shots.scene: 三只装透明液体的烧杯，看起来一模一样
shots.prompt_en: Three beakers of clear colorless liquid side by side, looking exactly alike. No people.
shots.narration: 很多溶液和溶剂，看上去都像水。
overlay: 使用中的容器临时贴标签

shots.section_title: 使用中的容器临时贴标签
shots.scene: 阿杰在空白标签上写字，贴到烧杯上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes on a small blank label and sticks it onto a beaker.
shots.narration: 使用中的烧杯和锥形瓶，临时贴上标签。

shots.section_title: 使用中的容器临时贴标签
shots.scene: 两只无标签烧杯的液体倒在一起冒泡的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid from two unlabeled beakers being poured together and bubbling, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没标签容易混淆，自己或别人会混错。

shots.section_title: 用小烧杯给滴定管加液
shots.scene: 大试剂瓶直接举高往滴定管倒的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person lifting a large reagent bottle high to pour straight into a burette, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 抱着大试剂瓶往滴定管倒，不好控制。
overlay: 用小烧杯给滴定管加液

shots.section_title: 用小烧杯给滴定管加液
shots.scene: 阿杰估算用量后，把滴定液倒进贴好标签的小烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, in goggles and gloves, pours some titrant from a reagent bottle into a small labeled beaker on a tray.
shots.narration: 先估算用量，多取一点到小烧杯里。

shots.section_title: 用小烧杯给滴定管加液
shots.scene: 阿杰用小烧杯平稳地向滴定管加液
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pours steadily from the small beaker into the burette through a small funnel.
shots.narration: 再用小烧杯加液，稳当得多。

shots.section_title: 擦净瓶外液滴，盖严瓶盖
shots.scene: 试剂瓶外壁挂着一道液滴的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a reagent bottle with a drip of liquid running down its outside wall. No people.
shots.narration: 倒完别让液滴顺着瓶壁往下流。
overlay: 擦净瓶外液滴，盖严瓶盖

shots.section_title: 擦净瓶外液滴，盖严瓶盖
shots.scene: 另一只手拿起湿瓶子的图标，旁边有警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand picking up a wet bottle, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 会造成小洒漏，下一个人还会摸到。

shots.section_title: 擦净瓶外液滴，盖严瓶盖
shots.scene: 阿杰用纸巾擦净瓶身，把瓶盖拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wipes the bottle with a paper towel and screws the cap on fully.
shots.narration: 擦净液滴，把瓶盖完全盖好。

shots.section_title: 滴定管加液：低于视线、慢倒、接盘
shots.scene: 滴定管顶端略低于阿杰眼睛的位置
shots.prompt_en: The young male student adjusts the burette clamp so the top of the burette sits just below his eye level.
shots.narration: 加液时，滴定管顶端略低于视线。
overlay: 滴定管加液：低于视线、慢倒、接盘

shots.section_title: 滴定管加液：低于视线、慢倒、接盘
shots.scene: 阿杰慢慢倒液，看着液面上升
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pours slowly through the funnel and watches the liquid level rise.
shots.narration: 慢慢倒，用漏斗时更要慢。

shots.section_title: 滴定管加液：低于视线、慢倒、接盘
shots.scene: 液体从滴定管顶端溢出的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid overflowing the top of a burette, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别超过滴定管的容量。

shots.section_title: 滴定管加液：低于视线、慢倒、接盘
shots.scene: 滴定管尖下方放着一只大烧杯
shots.prompt_en: A large empty beaker placed under the tip of the burette on the stand. No people.
shots.narration: 管尖下面放个大烧杯，接住洒漏。

shots.section_title: 移液管接洗耳球要轻
shots.scene: 双手特写：一手握住移液管靠近末端处，一手拿洗耳球
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands: one grips a pipette near its upper end, the other holds a rubber pipette bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 接洗耳球，手要握在移液管靠近末端处。
overlay: 移液管接洗耳球要轻

shots.section_title: 移液管接洗耳球要轻
shots.scene: 移液管轻轻插入洗耳球
shots.prompt_en: The pipette end is gently eased into the bulb opening. No people.
shots.narration: 轻轻插进去，不要硬塞。

shots.section_title: 移液管接洗耳球要轻
shots.scene: 握在中段用力硬插、移液管折断的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand gripping a pipette in the middle and forcing it into a bulb, the pipette snapping, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用力过猛，移液管折断会严重割伤。

shots.section_title: 移液严禁用嘴吸
shots.scene: 用嘴吸移液管的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a mouth sucking on a pipette, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 移液严禁用嘴吸。
overlay: 移液严禁用嘴吸

shots.section_title: 移液严禁用嘴吸
shots.scene: 洗耳球和移液辅助器两个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a rubber pipette bulb and a pipette filler, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 一律用洗耳球或移液辅助器。

shots.section_title: 不伸进原瓶，不倒回原瓶
shots.scene: 移液管伸进大试剂瓶的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pipette dipped straight into a large stock bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别把移液管直接伸进原试剂瓶。
overlay: 不伸进原瓶，不倒回原瓶

shots.section_title: 不伸进原瓶，不倒回原瓶
shots.scene: 阿杰把试剂倒进小烧杯，从小烧杯里移取
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pours some solution into a small labeled beaker and pipettes from the beaker.
shots.narration: 多取一点到小烧杯，再从烧杯里移取。

shots.section_title: 不伸进原瓶，不倒回原瓶
shots.scene: 小烧杯里的余液倒回原瓶的箭头，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from a small beaker back into the stock bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 多余的不能倒回原瓶，免得污染。

shots.section_title: 剩余试剂：分享或进废液桶
shots.scene: 阿杰把剩余溶液递给邻座的小研
shots.prompt_en: The young male student offers his leftover solution in a labeled beaker to the female graduate student at the next bench.
shots.narration: 剩下的溶液，可以分给需要的同学。
overlay: 剩余试剂：分享或进废液桶

shots.section_title: 剩余试剂：分享或进废液桶
shots.scene: 剩余溶液倒入贴空白标签的废液容器
shots.prompt_en: Leftover solution poured into a waste container with a blank label and a funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 没人要，就倒进规定的废液容器。

shots.section_title: 化学合成的两类危害
shots.scene: 欣欣站在烧瓶、电热板和过滤漏斗旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a flask, a hot plate and a filter funnel on a bench.
shots.narration: 化学合成，既有化学危害，也有操作危害。
overlay: 化学合成的两类危害

shots.section_title: 化学合成的两类危害
shots.scene: 流程图标：两杯溶液混合、加热搅拌、出现沉淀、过滤
shots.prompt_en: A row of process icons: two solutions mixing, a flask heated and stirred, a precipitate forming, and filtration through a funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 常见流程：混合、加热搅拌、沉淀、过滤。

shots.section_title: 称量：少量多次，多取不倒回
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着反应瓶和记录本走到天平旁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, in goggles and gloves, carries a reaction flask and a blank notebook to the balance.
shots.narration: 称量时，把反应瓶和记录本带到天平旁。
overlay: 称量：少量多次，多取不倒回

shots.section_title: 称量：少量多次，多取不倒回
shots.scene: 拿着试剂瓶直接往称量纸上倒的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bottle tipped to pour solid directly onto weighing paper on a balance, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别抱着瓶子直接往天平上倒。

shots.section_title: 称量：少量多次，多取不倒回
shots.scene: 阿杰用药匙一点一点往称量纸上加固体
shots.prompt_en: The young male student uses a small spatula to add solid onto weighing paper on the balance, a little at a time.
shots.narration: 用药匙少量多次地取。

shots.section_title: 称量：少量多次，多取不倒回
shots.scene: 多取的固体放进贴空白标签的固体废物容器
shots.prompt_en: Excess solid tipped from weighing paper into a solid waste container with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 取多了，放进废物容器，别倒回原瓶。

shots.section_title: 洒落即清，称完立即入瓶
shots.scene: 阿杰用小刷子把天平旁洒落的粉末扫进簸箕
shots.prompt_en: The young male student brushes spilled powder next to the balance into a small dustpan.
shots.narration: 天平旁洒了固体，马上清理进废物容器。
overlay: 洒落即清，称完立即入瓶

shots.section_title: 洒落即清，称完立即入瓶
shots.scene: 阿杰在天平旁把称好的固体直接倒进烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tips the weighed solid from the paper straight into the flask right at the balance.
shots.narration: 称好的固体，就地马上加进烧瓶。

shots.section_title: 洒落即清，称完立即入瓶
shots.scene: 托着称量纸穿过拥挤人群的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person carrying powder on a sheet of weighing paper through a crowded lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别托着称量纸穿过拥挤的实验室。

shots.section_title: 电热板：查电线、离热面、放干处
shots.scene: 小研拿起电热板电线检查，线皮完好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up the power cord of a hot plate and inspects it along its length.
shots.narration: 用电热板等电气设备，先查电线。
overlay: 电热板：查电线、离热面、放干处

shots.section_title: 电热板：查电线、离热面、放干处
shots.scene: 破损露线的电线图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a frayed power cord with exposed wires, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 线皮磨损、接头松动，就不能用。

shots.section_title: 电热板：查电线、离热面、放干处
shots.scene: 电线搭在加热面上、电热板放在水渍上的两个图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X: a cord lying across a hot plate surface, and a hot plate standing in a puddle of water. No people.
shots.narration: 电线别碰加热面，电热板放在干燥处。

shots.section_title: 有害气体和易燃溶剂进通风柜
shots.scene: 通风柜内烧瓶在加热，冒出的气体被吸走
shots.prompt_en: A flask heating inside a fume hood; vapor arrows rise and are drawn away up into the hood. No people.
shots.narration: 可能产生有害气体，就在通风柜里做。
overlay: 有害气体和易燃溶剂进通风柜

shots.section_title: 有害气体和易燃溶剂进通风柜
shots.scene: 易燃液体标志的瓶子和热源图标，中间有通风柜图标隔开
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with a flammable liquid warning sign and a heat source icon, separated by a fume hood icon with airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 用易燃有机溶剂的反应，也进通风柜。

shots.section_title: 有害气体和易燃溶剂进通风柜
shots.scene: 蒸气被排走，远离加热板的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of solvent vapor being swept away from a hot plate by airflow. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜排走蒸气，不让它碰到热源。

shots.section_title: 通风柜的正确使用
shots.scene: 老李指着通风柜上的风量指示灯
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points at the airflow indicator light on the front of a fume hood.
shots.narration: 用通风柜，先确认它在正常排风。
overlay: 通风柜的正确使用

shots.section_title: 通风柜的正确使用
shots.scene: 通风柜视窗拉到较低位置，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood with its sash pulled down low, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 视窗按要求拉低，身体在柜外操作。

shots.section_title: 通风柜的正确使用
shots.scene: 头伸进通风柜、柜内堆满杂物两个图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X: a head leaning inside a fume hood, and a hood crammed with clutter blocking the back. No people.
shots.narration: 不把头伸进去，柜里不堆杂物。

shots.section_title: 热物看不出来，用对钳子
shots.scene: 两只看起来一样的烧杯，一只热、一只冷
shots.prompt_en: Two identical beakers side by side; a faint heat glow icon hovers over one. No people.
shots.narration: 热玻璃和冷玻璃，看起来一模一样。
overlay: 热物看不出来，用对钳子

shots.section_title: 热物看不出来，用对钳子
shots.scene: 铁架台上的铁圈，旁边温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: An iron ring on a ring stand with a thermometer icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 刚加热过的铁圈，看着也和冷的一样。

shots.section_title: 热物看不出来，用对钳子
shots.scene: 徒手去抓热烧杯的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand grabbing a hot beaker, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 千万别直接用手去拿。

shots.section_title: 热物看不出来，用对钳子
shots.scene: 烧杯钳和坩埚钳并排，各配对应的烧杯和坩埚
shots.prompt_en: A beaker tongs icon paired with a beaker and a crucible tongs icon paired with a crucible, side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 烧杯用烧杯钳，坩埚用坩埚钳。

shots.section_title: 热物看不出来，用对钳子
shots.scene: 用错钳子，烧杯滑落摔碎的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beaker slipping from the wrong tongs and shattering, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 两种钳子不能混用，用错会掉落摔碎。

shots.section_title: 热物看不出来，用对钳子
shots.scene: 小研戴耐热手套，把锥形瓶从电热板上拿下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and thick heat-resistant gloves, lifts a flask off the hot plate.
shots.narration: 有时戴专用耐热手套更合适。

shots.section_title: 热器皿放在耐热表面
shots.scene: 热烧杯放在耐热垫上，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A hot beaker set down on a heat-resistant pad, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 热的烧杯烧瓶，只能放在耐热表面。
overlay: 热器皿放在耐热表面

shots.section_title: 热器皿放在耐热表面
shots.scene: 热烧杯放在纸本和塑料托盘上的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hot beaker placed on a paper notebook and a plastic tray, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别放在纸上、塑料上。

shots.section_title: 洒落立即清理
shots.scene: 台面上一小摊液体和撒开的粉末
shots.prompt_en: A small puddle of liquid and some scattered powder on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 固体或液体洒了，都要立即清理。
overlay: 洒落立即清理

shots.section_title: 洒落立即清理
shots.scene: 阿杰举手，小研拿着清理工具走来指导
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand; the female graduate student walks over with a spill cleanup kit to show him.
shots.narration: 告诉老师，由老师处理或教你处理。

shots.section_title: 化学品溅到身上怎么办
shots.scene: 欣欣指着洗眼器标志和紧急喷淋标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at an eyewash sign and an emergency shower sign on the wall.
shots.narration: 溅到皮肤或眼睛，立即冲洗。
overlay: 化学品溅到身上怎么办

shots.section_title: 化学品溅到身上怎么办
shots.scene: 阿杰在洗眼器前冲洗眼睛，小研在旁扶着
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his eyes at an eyewash station while the female graduate student supports him.
shots.narration: 眼睛用洗眼器，用大量清水持续冲。

shots.section_title: 化学品溅到身上怎么办
shots.scene: 小研向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man at the lab doorway; he listens and nods.
shots.narration: 冲洗后马上报告老师，需要就医就医。

shots.section_title: 实验个人防护基本要求
shots.scene: 欣欣展示实验服、护目镜、手套和合脚的鞋
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot presents a lab coat, safety goggles, gloves and closed-toe shoes on a rack.
shots.narration: 进实验室，实验服、护目镜要穿戴好。
overlay: 实验个人防护基本要求

shots.section_title: 实验个人防护基本要求
shots.scene: 手套图标按不同化学品配不同颜色，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Glove icons in different colors matched to different chemical bottle icons, with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 手套按化学品选，破了及时更换。

shots.section_title: 实验个人防护基本要求
shots.scene: 长发束起、合脚鞋打勾；拖鞋、披发、饮食图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons with green checks for tied-back hair and closed shoes; icons for sandals, loose hair and food and drink, crossed out with red X. No people.
shots.narration: 长发束起，不穿凉拖，实验室不饮食。

shots.section_title: 废物分类、标识、盖好
shots.scene: 阿杰把剩余溶液递给同学
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a labeled beaker of leftover solution to a classmate.
shots.narration: 实验结束，剩余试剂能分享就分享。
overlay: 废物分类、标识、盖好

shots.section_title: 废物分类、标识、盖好
shots.scene: 实验室角落的废物收集站，一排贴空白标签的容器
shots.prompt_en: A waste collection station in a corner of the lab with a row of closed containers bearing blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里有废物收集站，分好几类容器。

shots.section_title: 废物分类、标识、盖好
shots.scene: 阿杰核对标签，把废液倒进对应的容器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, in goggles and gloves, checks a container's label and pours waste in through a funnel.
shots.narration: 每种废物，放进正确标识的容器。

shots.section_title: 废物分类、标识、盖好
shots.scene: 两种废液倒在一起冒烟爆裂的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two different waste liquids mixing and bursting with smoke, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 混入不相容的化学品，可能引起爆炸。

shots.section_title: 废物分类、标识、盖好
shots.scene: 阿杰合上废液容器的盖子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes the lid of the waste container firmly.
shots.narration: 加完废物，随手盖好容器。

shots.section_title: 危险废物不进下水道
shots.scene: 试剂倒进水槽下水道的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of chemical waste being poured down a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 化学废液不能倒进下水道。
overlay: 危险废物不进下水道

shots.section_title: 危险废物不进下水道
shots.scene: 王老师在废物收集站核对登记本，旁边有运输车图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank log sheet at the waste station, with a small transport truck icon beside him.
shots.narration: 学校统一收集，交有资质的单位处置。

shots.section_title: 水槽不留物，碎玻璃告诉老师
shots.scene: 阿杰在水槽边清洗烧瓶，戴着手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing gloves, washes a flask with a brush at the lab sink.
shots.narration: 清洗器皿时，水槽里不要留东西。
overlay: 水槽不留物，碎玻璃告诉老师

shots.section_title: 水槽不留物，碎玻璃告诉老师
shots.scene: 水槽底部藏着碎玻璃的图标，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of broken glass hidden at the bottom of a sink under water, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 水槽里的碎玻璃，最容易割伤人。

shots.section_title: 水槽不留物，碎玻璃告诉老师
shots.scene: 阿杰停手，叫来小研
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops and calls the female graduate student over to look into the sink.
shots.narration: 发现碎玻璃，马上告诉老师。

shots.section_title: 碎玻璃收集与割伤处置
shots.scene: 小研用镊子和小簸箕收集碎玻璃
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing thick gloves, collects broken glass pieces with tongs and a small dustpan.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃用工具收，不徒手捡。
overlay: 碎玻璃收集与割伤处置

shots.section_title: 碎玻璃收集与割伤处置
shots.scene: 碎玻璃倒进专用的碎玻璃收集盒
shots.prompt_en: Broken glass tipped into a dedicated sturdy broken glass box with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 放进专用碎玻璃盒，不进普通垃圾。

shots.section_title: 碎玻璃收集与割伤处置
shots.scene: 手指流血时在水龙头下冲洗，旁边急救箱图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cut finger rinsed under a tap, with a first aid kit icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 被割伤，冲洗止血，报告老师。

shots.section_title: 擦净台面，器材归位
shots.scene: 阿杰用湿海绵擦拭台面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wipes down the bench with a damp sponge.
shots.narration: 用湿纸巾或海绵，把台面擦干净。
overlay: 擦净台面，器材归位

shots.section_title: 擦净台面，器材归位
shots.scene: 器材依次放回柜子原位
shots.prompt_en: Clean glassware and equipment placed back in their marked places in a cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 所有器材，放回原来的位置。

shots.section_title: 确认燃气阀已关
shots.scene: 阿杰俯身检查台面燃气阀把手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends to check the handle of the gas valve on the bench.
shots.narration: 用过燃气灯，再确认一次燃气阀已关。
overlay: 确认燃气阀已关

shots.section_title: 确认燃气阀已关
shots.scene: 燃气阀把手处于关闭位置，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A gas valve icon with its handle in the closed position and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 阀门关好，才能离开。

shots.section_title: 加热不离人，离开断电断气
shots.scene: 加热板上的烧瓶旁空无一人的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a flask heating on a hot plate with nobody around, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 加热中的实验，不能无人看管。
overlay: 加热不离人，离开断电断气

shots.section_title: 加热不离人，离开断电断气
shots.scene: 小研关掉电热板电源，拔下插头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off a hot plate and unplugs it.
shots.narration: 离开前，断电、断气、关水。

shots.section_title: 加热不离人，离开断电断气
shots.scene: 燃气灯火焰与易燃溶剂瓶之间的距离箭头
shots.prompt_en: A burner flame icon and a flammable liquid bottle icon far apart, with a long distance arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 明火附近，不放易燃溶剂。

shots.section_title: 正确摘手套，最后洗手
shots.scene: 阿杰捏住手套腕口，由内向外翻着摘下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pinches one glove at the wrist and peels it off inside out without touching the outside.
shots.narration: 一次性手套，翻着摘，手别碰外面。
overlay: 正确摘手套，最后洗手

shots.section_title: 正确摘手套，最后洗手
shots.scene: 摘下的手套放进指定的废物容器
shots.prompt_en: Used gloves dropped into a designated waste bin with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 按老师要求丢进指定容器。

shots.section_title: 正确摘手套，最后洗手
shots.scene: 阿杰用洗手液在水龙头下认真洗手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his hands thoroughly with soap under the tap.
shots.narration: 最后，认真洗手再离开。

shots.section_title: 时刻留意，实验前想四步
shots.scene: 欣欣站在整洁的实验室中，周围同学在各自操作
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a tidy lab while students work carefully at their benches around it.
shots.narration: 时刻留意自己在做什么，也看看别人。
overlay: 时刻留意，实验前想四步

shots.section_title: 时刻留意，实验前想四步
shots.scene: 阿杰提醒旁边同学盖好瓶盖
shots.prompt_en: The young male student taps a classmate on the shoulder and points at an open bottle.
shots.narration: 看到别人有隐患，及时提醒。

shots.section_title: 时刻留意，实验前想四步
shots.scene: 四个台阶图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 每次实验前，都把四步想一遍。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现整洁台面、标签、护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a tidy bench, a blank label and safety goggles.
shots.narration: 台面整洁，容器贴标签，防护穿戴好。
overlay: 小结

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 小烧杯、洗耳球、药匙三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a small beaker, a pipette bulb and a spatula. No people.
shots.narration: 小烧杯取用，不进原瓶，不倒回。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 通风柜、钳子、耐热垫图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood, a pair of tongs and a heat-resistant pad. No people.
shots.narration: 气体进通风柜，热物用钳子。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 废液容器、碎玻璃盒、燃气阀、洗手图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lidded waste container, a broken glass box, a closed gas valve and hand washing. No people.
shots.narration: 废物分类，关阀断电，洗手离开。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在整洁的实验台前一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye at the camera beside a clean, tidy lab bench.
shots.narration: 好习惯天天用，实验更安全，下次见！
